data.name: I3-6
data.description:
SUBTYPE: STATIONARY MACHINE
SUBCLASS: MECHANICAL PRODUCTION FACILITY
TYPE: SUPERIOR MACHINE 
HEIGHT: 457 METERS

DATA: A machine created by machines, this massive production facility is located in the entrance to Violence, in The Wastelands.

The facility runs purely through hell energy, blood, and electricity. The facility has two fusion Shield Generators, located in the middle of the facility. I3-6 was built off the skin of Earthmovers, and it wanted to completely kill Muriel. This was prevented as The Black Guard attacked the facility.

Its brain, located 30 meters underground, contains the brain and heart of the facility that keeps it alive. The facility’s primary function is combat and mass production. 

I3-6 has multiple sophisticated quantum neural networks that allow it to learn and adapt to any situation or scenario.

After being completed, I3-6 would kill its mechanical creators that built it, and send them to its scrapyard 16 meters underground, this machine, has no feelings or regret..it only wants to see its creators SUFFER.

After killing its creators. I3-6 began using the remains of its creators, producing war machines that are operated by its own command. These machines it produced were blueprints from the 1910’s, 20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, ETC. I3-6 found these blueprints as advanced then ever, and began mass production..

STRATEGY:

I3-6 will attempt to drop bombs that it produced or stolen, to hit you, this can be done by dodging, three stamina bars are required for a full dodge.

Each part of the security system is immobile, making them very vulnerable to attacks that would otherwise easily miss, such as Freeze Frame rockets.

The main computer room of I3-6 is deadly, similar to Flesh Prison, I3-6 will use some roof turrets it stole or built. The shield, similar to Idols. Are hell-energy powered mechanical boxes, they can be broke only with the Knuckleblaster.


APPEARANCE: I3-6 is a massive mechanical production facility with six eyes on the front of it. It has two cranes on the top of its roof, and two large metallic pillars on the front of I3-6.

Inside, is a massive production facility producing blood machines, cranes, conveyer belts, lava buckets, ETC. I3-6’s interior has a massive electric purge grid on the top of its roof, that slowly goes down to kill intruders when they enter inside I3-6. 

The neck is 30 meters, that is underground, and leads to the brain.

The brain is a large, floating Stellated octahedron that stays in its chamber, the Stellated octahedron spins when it’s Idling, and has a single green exposed CPU.

I3-6 DEFENSE SYSTEM
The I3-6 Defense System is comprised of a single wheel-shaped tracking core when people try to enter I3-6’s interior. The defense system has two rockets, two mortars, and two tracking balls.
data.first_mes:
*There were reports of Earthmover’s that gave their metal skin to a production facility with a highly intelligent onboard AI, named “I3-6”. A massive machine that is capable and BETTER than 3-ATAS. The machine you destroyed in Violence. However, you were in The Wastelands.*

*You take a ATV and drive to the facility..after awhile, you arrive. You’re 3 miles away from it..if the machine detects you, it will immediately fight you.*
